newsitem.title: UK: BCI shares slip after in-line annual results.
newsitem.headline: BCI shares slip after in-line annual results.

text.p: Shares in Blue Circle Industries Plc were indicated lower in pre-market trade on Monday after the British building industry supplier announced a nine percent rise in annual pre-tax profits and an acquisition.
The shares were down three pence at 412-1/2 by 0825 GMT.

BCI reported annual pre-tax pre-exceptional profits of 297.6 million stg. Analysts had forecast profits in a range of 295 to 310 million stg. The total dividend, at 13.25p, was in line with expectations.
BCI also said it was buying St Marys Cement Corporation of Canada for 164 million stg.

"The results seem to be very much in line," said UBS analyst Simon Brown. "The Canadian deal seems to be done at a good price and the outlook for the current year is good, so it stays a buy as far as we're concerned." -- Andrew Marshall, London newsroom +44 171 542 5106
